description: Reply to the sender of an inbox message (comms scope). body is the reply text; it threads and quotes the original. Optional mailbox_id picks the From (else your default sender — or, when the message is a lead's answer in a cold-email conversation, the mailbox that emailed them; `note` in the result says so). dry_run=true previews without sending.

body.description: The message or email body (HTML or text, per the tool).

dry_run.description: If true, preview the result without sending or saving anything.

id.description: The record's numeric id, from the matching list/get/search tool.

name: reply_to_inbox_message
title: Reply To Inbox Message
